pattern.signal_summary: Per-attempt random Git refs made attempts unique but did not force concurrent actors to contend on one exclusion claim.

interpretation: Attempt journaling and singleton authority are different invariants. A safe one-time operation needs a canonical atomic claim shared by all contenders, downstream authority binding, and stale/recovery semantics.
expected_effect: Prevent concurrency races where multiple uniquely identified attempts each believe they hold singleton authority.

success_metrics.notes: Adversarial concurrent-contender case must remain covered.

success_metrics.target: no increase attributable to claim design
success_metrics.notes: Candidate must not move races later into runtime.

notes: Native Candidate exists at skills/exclusive-claim-analysis. Additional real use outside the originating design is required before broad Stable claims.
